result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.quotient_graph()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Create a quotient graph from a node partition. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L12301-L12411){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.quotient_graph(partition) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Each block (group of nodes) in the partition becomes a single node in the quotient graph. Edges between different blocks become edges in the quotient. Edges within the same block are removed. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [partition]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[list[int | str]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : List of node groups. Each inner list contains node IDs or labels belonging to the same block. Every node must appear exactly once. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new quotient graph where each partition block is a node. Nodes are labeled `"block_0"`, `"block_1"`, etc. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If any node in the partition does not exist. [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If a node appears in multiple blocks or if some nodes are missing. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} - every node must appear in exactly one block - intra-block edges are discarded (no self-loops in quotient) - edge weights from the first inter-block edge are preserved - quotient nodes are numbered `1, 2, 3, ...` with labels `"block_0"`, etc. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Create quotient from community partition: ::: {#f8dde1d2 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph(directed=False) g.add_path_graph(6) # 1 -- 2 -- 3 -- 4 -- 5 -- 6 # Partition: {1,2,3} and {4,5,6} partition = [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]] quotient = g.quotient_graph(partition) # Returns 2 quotient.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#90018f15 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Returns 1 (from edge 3-4) quotient.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 1 ``` ::: ::: Quotient from community detection: ::: {#c60b1dd4 .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} g = ec.Graph(directed=False) g.add_path_graph(20) # Build a simple graph # Detect communities (use return_dict=True to get dict) membership = g.cmty_louvain(return_dict=True) # Build partition from membership from collections import defaultdict communities = defaultdict(list) for node, comm in membership.items(): communities[comm].append(node) partition = list(communities.values()) # Create quotient graph showing inter-community edges quotient = g.quotient_graph(partition) # Number of communities quotient.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` 9 ``` ::: ::: ::: {#227c9ef4 .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Number of inter-community edges quotient.count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` 8 ``` ::: ::: Using labels: ::: {#460fa2e5 .cell execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} g = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "D") ) # Partition by labels quotient = g.quotient_graph([["A", "B"], ["C", "D"]]) # Results in block_0 -- block_1 ``` :::
